questions.question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.**

Tarapur agreement guaranteed supplies of

P: Tarapur reactors for entire life

Q: enriched uranium fuel from

R: the US for running the
questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is **QRP**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**:-

 
• A sentence can't end with **fuel from **or **the** i.e.** P** has to be last.
 
• Thus, we can eliminate** option 1 **and** 4**.
 
• **R** can't be first as it starts with **the US **and you can't have supplies of a country.
 
• Supplies is of a material i.e. uranium in the context of the sentence.
 
• Thus,** Q** will be the first sentence.
 
• Therefore, the correct sequence is **QRP**.

 

***Correct Sentence - **Tarapur agreement guaranteed supplies of enriched uranium fuel from the US for running the Tarapur reactors for entire life. *

questions.question:
**A sentence has been given in Active/Passive Voice. Out of the four given alternatives, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Passive/Active Voice.**

Viraat threw the stone.

options.text: The stone got threw by Viraat.
The stone is thrown by Viraat.
The stone was thrown by Viraat.

questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is **The stone was thrown by Viraat.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**:-

__
 
• The above-given sentence is in the active voice. 
 
• We need to change it in the passive voice.
 
• The following steps are required to change the given sentence into **passive voice**:-
 
 
• The subject 'Viraat' of the active voice will become the object of the passive voice.
 
• The object 'the stone' of the active voice will become the subject of the passive voice.
 
• The tense(simple past tense) will change according to the following structure:-
 
 
• Active Voice - Subject + (did + V1) or (V2)+ Object.
 
• Passive Voice - Object + was/were + V3 + by + Object.
 
 
 
 

Therefore, the correct passive voice is *The stone was thrown by Viraat.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When we convert active voice to passive voice, three things need to be kept in mind:-

 
 
• Change object into subject.
 
• Change subject into object.
 
• Always use the third form of verb in the passive voice.
 
• Use 'by' before the new object.

questions.question:
**A sentence has been given in Direct/Indirect Speech. Out of the four given alternatives, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Indirect/Direct Speech.**

“You have all done very badly!” remarked the mother.

options.text: The mother asked if they have done badly.
The mother remarked that they have did it badly.
The mother said that they had done badly.
The mother remarked that they had all done very badly.

questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is **The mother remarked that they had all done very badly.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**:-

__
 
• Let's look at the steps for changing the sentence from direct to indirect speech:
 
• As the reporting verb is in the **past tense** and direct speech is in the **present perfect tense, **we will take the following steps:-
 
 
• The reporting verb 'remarked' is unchanged.
 
• The conjunction 'that' is used in place of the comma and the inverted comma are removed.
 
• The present perfect **tense** is changed to past perfect tense in the direct speech.(**Have** changes to **had**)
 
• Since you is being used in the plural sense here (notice all), it changes to they.
 
• 
 
We can't just remove any piece of info from the sentence. Notice how option 3 doesn't contain all and very.

 
 
 

Therefore, the correct indirect speech is *The mother remarked that they had all done very badly.*

 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

The following table will enable us to know how tense changes in indirect speech:-

 
 

 Direct Speech
 Indirect Speech
 
 

 Simple Present* (Subject + V1 + Object)*
 Simple Past* (Subject + V2 + Object)*
 
 

 Present Continuous *(Subject + is/am/are + V1 + ing + Object)*
 Past Continuous *(Subject + was/were + V1 + ing + Object)*
 
 

 Present Perfect *(Subject + has/have + V3 + Object)*
 Past Perfect* (Subject + had + V3 + Object)*
 
 

 Simple Past* (Subject + V2 + Object)*
 Past Perfect *(Subject + had + V3 + Object)*
 
 

 Past Continuous *(Subject + was/were + V1 + ing + Object)*
 Past Perfect Continuous* (Subject + had been + V1 + ing + Object)*
 
 

 Simple Future *(Subject + will/shall + V1 + Object)*
 Present Conditional *(Subject + would + V1 +Object)*
 
 

 Future Continuous *(Subject + will/shall + V1 + ing + Object)*
 Conditional Continuous *(Subject + would + be + V1 + ing + Object)*

questions.question: Among four cars, weight of T1 is twice the weight of T2. Weight of T3 is half of the weight of T2. T4 is 25 kg heavier than T2, but 25 kg lighter than T1. What is the difference (in kg) between the weight of T4 and T3?
questions.solution:
According to question:

T1 = 2T2 _____________ (i)

T3 = (1/2) T2 → 2T3 = T2 _____________ (ii)

T4 = T2 + 25 _____________ (iii)

T4 = T1 – 25 _____________ (iv)

On subtracting equation (iii) from equation (iv), we get :

T4 – T4 = T2 – T1 + 25 – (–25)

→ 0 = T2 – T1 + 25 + 25

→ T1 – T2 = 50 _____________ (v)

Substituting the value of T1 in equation (v) from equation (i), we get

2T2 – T2 = 50

→ T2 = 50

Therefore, T1 = 100, T3 = T2/2 = 50/2 = 25 and T4 = T2 + 25 = 50 + 25 = 75

Therefore, T4 – T3 = 75 – 25 = 50

Hence, answer is ‘50’.

questions.question: If the population of a town increases by 25% in the first year and increases by 36% in the second year, then what is the average rate (in percentage)of increase in the population?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Increase in population

First year = 25%, Second year = 36%

**Formula used:**

Average rate of increase (in %) = (1/2) × Total increment ×** **100

**Calculation:**

Let the initial population of the town be 100.

Population after first year = 100 + 25% of 100 = 100 + 25 = 125

Population after second year = 125 + 36% of 125 = 125 + 45 = 170

Total increment = (170 – 100)/100 = 7/10

Average rate of increase (in %) = (1/2) × (7/10) × 100 = 35%

**∴ The correct answer is 35%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Calculation:**

Equivalent increase = 25 + 36 + (25 × 36)/100 = 70%

Average increase = 70/2 = 35%.

**∴ The average increase is 35%.**

questions.question: U, V, and W together can make a chair in 20 minutes. U and V together can make it in 25 minutes. How much time (in minutes) will W take to make the chair alone?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Time taken by U, V, and W together to make a chair = 20 min

Time taken by U and V together to make a chair = 25 min

**CALCULATION:**

Time taken by U, V, and W together to make a chair = 20 min

Time taken by U and V together to make a chair = 25 min

Let total work = LCM of 20 and 25 = 100 units

Efficiency of U, V, and W together = 100/20 = 5 units/min

Efficiency of U and V together = 100/25 = 4 units/min

Efficiency of W = 5 – 4 = 1 unit/min

**∴ Time taken by W to make a chair alone = 100 × 1 = 100 min**

questions.question: The gravitational force of attraction between two bodies is ________ the distance between the two bodies.

options.text: Directly proportional to the square of
Inversely proportional to the square of

questions.solution:
__CONCEPT__:

__
 
• Law of Universal Gravitation: It states that all objects attract each other with a force that is proportional to the masses of two objects and inversely proportional to the square of the distance that separates their centres.
 
• It is given mathematically as follows:

F = (Gm₁m₂)/(R²)

Where m1 and m2 are the mass of two objects, G is the gravitational constant and R is the distance between their centres.

EXPLANATION__:

__
 
• The gravitational force of attraction between two bodies is inversely proportional to the square of the distance between the two bodies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• From the universal law of gravitation,
 
 
• The force is attractive in nature.
 
• The distance between the two objects is their centre-to-centre distance, and hence the force acts along the line joining the centres. Therefore, it is a central force.
 
 
 
• Non-contact force is a force that acts on an object without being in contact with the object. Since gravitational force acts without each body being in contact with another body, it is a non-contact force.

questions.question: Find the acceleration (in m/s²) of a body which accelerates from 15 m/s to 40 m/s in 2 seconds.
questions.solution:

• The acceleration of a body that accelerates from 15 m/s to 40 m/s in 2 seconds is 12.5 m/s².
 
• Initial velocity = 15m/s and Final velocity = 40m/s.
 
• So net velocity = 40 ‐15(m/s) which is equal to 25m/s.
 
• Now formula for acceleration= net velocity/time
 
• Therefore here, acceleration = 25/2 = 12.5 m/s².

• **Ghoomar **is a traditional folk dance of **Rajasthan, India and Sindh‚ Pakistan.**
 
• The dance is chiefly performed by veiled women who wear flowing dresses called **ghaghara**.
 
• The dance typically involves performers pirouetting while moving in and out of a wide circle.
 
• The word ghoomna describes the twirling movement of the dancers and is the basis of the word ghoomar.
 
• **Ghoomar is often performed on special occasions, such as at weddings and during Holi and sometimes lasts for hours.**

questions.question: Which of the following range is known as 'Sahyadri'?
questions.solution:
The Western Ghats are also known as 'Sahyadri'.

 
• They run in the north-south direction forming the western edge of the Deccan Plateau.
 
• They are about 1600km in extent, from the Tapi Valley in the North to almost Kanyakumari in the South.

questions.question: Where is located the most active volcano in the world?
questions.solution:
The most active volcano in the world is located around the Pacific Ocean.

 
• Currently, Kilauea is the world’s most active volcano, located in Hawaii.
 
• There are about 1500 active volcanoes in the world, most of which are located around Pacific Rim, known as Ring of Fire.
 
• Ring of Fire includes South American and North American plates, the Bougainville, Mariana Islands, New Zealand, Tonga, and the Philippines, Japan, Indonesia, etc.

questions.question: Economic Survey is published by ________.
questions.solution:
Economic Survey is published by the __**Ministry of Finance.**__

 
• Every year, before presenting the **Union Budget**, the Finance Ministry of India presents an Economic survey in Parliament.
 
• *The Economic Survey throws light on*-
 
 
• The performance on major development programs
 
• Annual economic development
 
• The policy initiatives took by the government
 
• The prospects of the economy in the short to medium term

questions.question: The term "Smart Money" broadly refers to ________.
questions.solution:
The term “Smart Money” broadly refers to credit cards.

 
• Credit cards allow us to borrow money from the credit provider to pay for something without using your cash or savings in a bank account.
 
• There's a limit to borrow money (called credit limit) and one has to pay it back.
